# obol.experimental

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../../sdk/index.md).

:::

Features whose result shapes may still change in a minor release. `simulate` runs a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) request on the node without sending it (`eth_simulateV1`, else `debug_traceCall`, else `eth_call`) and returns balance changes, events, state changes, plain-language `summary` lines and a comparison with the operation's own preview. `legacy` reads 2.x-era OWR contracts.

## Simulation {#group-simulate}

### experimental.simulate {#simulate}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain, **experimental** (its result shape may change in a minor release)</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 2</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">5 warnings</span></div>

Runs a prepared request on the node without sending it and reports what
it would do (spec/operations.md "simulate").

```ts sdk-signature
obol.experimental.simulate(
  prepared: AnyPrepared,
  options?: SimulateOptions,
): Promise<Simulation>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>prepared</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#AnyPrepared">AnyPrepared</a></span> |  |
| <code>options?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/experimental#SimulateOptions">SimulateOptions</a></span> |  |
| <code>options.from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Address</span> | The sender: default the wallet account. A Safe simulates as the Safe (msg.sender). |
| <code>options.blockNumber?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint &#124; 'latest'</span> | The block to simulate on top of: default the latest block (pass `prepared.blockNumber` to pin it). |
| <code>options.backend?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/experimental#SimulationBackend">SimulationBackend</a> &#124; 'auto'</span> | Force a backend; default `auto` (eth_simulateV1, then debug_traceCall, then eth_call). |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/experimental#Simulation">Simulation</a>&gt;</span>

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#PREPARED_INVALID">PREPARED_INVALID</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#SIMULATION_FAILED">SIMULATION_FAILED</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE" title="warning">SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#SIMULATION_REVERTED" title="warning">SIMULATION_REVERTED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH" title="warning">SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE" title="warning">SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT" title="warning">SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--info" href="../warnings#SIMULATION_CONTRACT_WALLET" title="info">SIMULATION_CONTRACT_WALLET</a>

**Example**

```ts
import { warningCodes } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const prepared = await obol.ovm.prepareDistribute({ ovm: ovmAddress });
const simulation = await obol.experimental.simulate(prepared, { from: account });
if (!simulation.success) throw new Error(simulation.summary[0]); // "Reverts: …"
simulation.summary.forEach(line => console.log(line));
await obol.send(prepared, { simulation, acknowledge: warningCodes(prepared, simulation) });
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: simulate</summary>

Tag: `chain`, **experimental** (its result shape may change in a minor release). Bound as
`obol.experimental.simulate(prepared, options?)`; also the export `experimental.simulate(ctx, prepared, options?)`
(`@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/experimental`).
Runs `prepared.request` as sent by `from`, without sending anything, and says what it would do. `prepareX` stays pure:
the pattern is prepare → simulate → show `summary` and the findings → `send(prepared, { simulation, acknowledge })`.

Input: [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) and `{ from: Address?, blockNumber: bigint | 'latest'?, backend: 'auto' | 'eth_simulateV1' |
'debug_traceCall' | 'eth_call'? }`.

1. `prepared` as `send` 1–2 ([`PREPARED_INVALID`](../errors.md#PREPARED_INVALID), [`CHAIN_MISMATCH`](../errors.md#CHAIN_MISMATCH)); options decoded ([`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID)).
2. G2: a chain with Obol contracts, else [`UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN`](../errors.md#UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN).
3. A sender: `from`, else the wallet account, else [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID).
4. The block simulated on top of: `blockNumber` (pass `prepared.blockNumber` to pin the state the preview read),
   else the latest block, so the answer is "what happens if sent now". A node that no longer has the state of a
   pinned block answers with an error: [`SIMULATION_FAILED`](../errors.md#SIMULATION_FAILED).
5. The sender has contract code that is not an EIP-7702 delegation: Finding [`SIMULATION_CONTRACT_WALLET`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_CONTRACT_WALLET). The call is
   simulated with the contract wallet (a Safe) as `msg.sender` and `tx.origin`; its own signature, owner, threshold
   and nonce checks are not simulated.
6. The backend. In `auto`, `eth_simulateV1`, then `debug_traceCall`, then `eth_call`: a backend the node lacks, or
   whose request it answers with any JSON-RPC error (rejected parameters, an option it does not support), is skipped
   for the next one. A node answering "method not found" / "not supported" / "invalid params" is not asked for that
   method again (per `PublicClient`); other error answers are retried on the next call. A transport failure (no
   JSON-RPC answer) is [`SIMULATION_FAILED`](../errors.md#SIMULATION_FAILED).
   - `eth_simulateV1` with `traceTransfers: true`, `validation: false`: the call, then (after success) one more
     simulated block of `[reads, call, reads]` for the before / after values. ETH moved inside the call comes from the
     synthetic transfer logs (`0xeeee…eeee`); those logs are not reported as events.
   - `debug_traceCall`: `callTracer` with `withLog: true` (success, gas, logs of frames that did not revert, the first
     failing inner call) and `prestateTracer` with `diffMode: true` (accounts whose ETH balance changes); before
     values with `eth_call`, after values with `eth_call` and the post-state diff as state overrides (a slot in `pre`
     and not in `post` was cleared).
   - `eth_call`: success or revert only; the result is `limited: true` with Finding [`SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE)
     (warning since 3.0.0-rc.12) naming each skipped backend and why (unless `eth_call` was forced). An `eth_call` error that is not an execution failure
     (a revert, out of gas, insufficient funds) is [`SIMULATION_FAILED`](../errors.md#SIMULATION_FAILED), not a revert.
     A forced backend that the node lacks or that fails is [`SIMULATION_FAILED`](../errors.md#SIMULATION_FAILED). No gas is charged in any backend, so
     balance changes exclude gas fees; `gas` reports it apart: `used` from the backend, `estimatedFee = used ×
(baseFeePerGas of the simulated block + eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas)`, `null` when either read fails.
7. A revert is not an error: `success: false`, `revertReason` and Finding [`SIMULATION_REVERTED`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_REVERTED). Revert data is
   decoded with the custom errors of the OVM (and solady `Ownable` / `SafeTransferLib`), the OVM factory, the
   PullSplit factory, the split wallet, the Warehouse and the Merkle distributor, plus `Error(string)` and
   `Panic(uint256)`. For a Multicall3 `aggregate3` batch, `revertReason.inner` is the first required call that failed
   (`eth_simulateV1`: the calls simulated one by one from Multicall3; `debug_traceCall`: the failing frame).
8. Reads, before and after, through Multicall3 (each read may fail): the ETH balance of `from`, `to` and every address
   ETH moved to or from; the Warehouse native-token balance of every address in a native-token `Transfer`
   (ERC-6909: deposits, split distributions, withdrawals); `amountOfPrincipalStake` and `fundsPendingWithdrawal` of
   every OVM the call touches (an OVM event emitter, or an OVM write in the request or in a batch); `rolesOf` before,
   for each `RolesUpdated`.
9. Trusted emitters. Only events from an address with a known role in this transaction are interpreted (reads,
   state changes, summary lines, the comparison): the chain's OVM and PullSplit factories, Warehouse, SplitMain,
   Multicall3, batch deposit contract, OBOL token, the deposit contract, the EIP-7002 / EIP-7251 predeploys; the
   request's `to` and, for a Multicall3 batch, each call's target; the addresses the preview names (the OVM, its
   principal and reward recipients, the splits, a predicted split, the factory, the claim contract); contracts a
   trusted factory created in this transaction (`CreateObolValidatorManager`, `SplitCreated`). Every event is still
   listed in `events`, with `trusted`. A decoded event from any other address produces only a neutral last summary
   line, `Unrecognised contract 0x1234…abcd emitted Withdraw(…)`, and Finding [`SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT). ETH
   balance changes do not depend on events: they come from the trace.
10. The comparison with `preview` (below); a difference is Finding [`SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH). When the simulated
    block is not `prepared.blockNumber`, its message says the state moved since prepare and to prepare again
    (`details.stateMoved`).

Output (`limited: false`, backends `eth_simulateV1` / `debug_traceCall`):

```ts sdk-spec
{
  limited: false; backend; from; blockNumber; success: boolean; revertReason?: RevertReason;
  gas: { used: bigint, baseFeePerGas: bigint | null, priorityFeePerGas: bigint | null, estimatedFee: bigint | null };
  balanceChanges: { address, asset: 'ETH' | 'WAREHOUSE_ETH', label?, before, after, delta }[];
  events: { address, name, args, known }[];
  stateChanges: StateChange[];
  summary: string[];
  matchesPreview: { status: 'match' | 'mismatch' | 'notCompared', ok: boolean,
                    differences: string[], compared: string[], notCompared: string[] };
  findings: Finding[];
  request: { to, data, value, chainId };   // what was simulated; send(prepared, { simulation }) checks it
}
type RevertReason = { message, name?, args?, data?, inner?: { index, target, reason: RevertReason } }
```

With `limited: true` (`eth_call`): `{ limited, backend: 'eth_call', request, from, blockNumber, success,
revertReason?, findings, summary }`.

- `balanceChanges`: only non-zero deltas; ETH first (the sender first, then by address), then Warehouse balances
  labelled `warehouse:<address>`. Other labels name known addresses: `sender`, `OVM`, `new OVM`, `new split`,
  `Warehouse`, `deposit contract`, `EIP-7002 predeploy`, `EIP-7251 predeploy`, `Obol RAF`, and from the preview
  `principal recipient`, `reward recipient`, `reward split`, `principal split`, `split recipient`,
  `excess fee recipient`.
- `events`: every log of the call in order, each `{ address, name, args, known, trusted }`, decoded with the ABIs above, the deposit contract (`DepositEvent`), the
  PullSplit proxy `ReceiveETH`, ERC-20 `Transfer` and Merkle `Claimed`; the EIP-7002 / EIP-7251 system contracts emit
  an anonymous log per request, decoded as `WithdrawalRequest { sourceAddress, validatorPubkey, amountGwei }` /
  `ConsolidationRequest { sourceAddress, sourcePubkey, targetPubkey }`. Anything else is `name: 'Unknown'` with
  `topics` and `data`.
- `stateChanges`, in this order: requests sent straight to a predeploy (from calldata); `created` contracts (an OVM
  from the chain's OVM factory `CreateObolValidatorManager`, a split from the PullSplit factory `SplitCreated`);
  then from events in order: `withdrawalRequest` / `consolidationRequest` (OVM events, with the fee), `deposit` (the
  deposit contract's `DepositEvent`, little-endian amount), `ownership`, `ownershipHandover`, `recipient`
  (`BeneficiaryUpdated` = principal, `RewardRecipientUpdated` = reward), `splitUpdated`, `paused` (events of a
  contract created in the call are not changes); then `roles` per OVM and user (`before` from `rolesOf`, `after` the
  last `RolesUpdated`, `granted` / `revoked` role names); then `value` changes of `amountOfPrincipalStake` and
  `fundsPendingWithdrawal`.
- `summary`: one line per state change (created contracts, `Validator 0xabcd1234…ef01 full exit requested
(irreversible)`, consolidations, deposits, `Role CONSOLIDATION granted to 0x…`, ownership, recipients, values), the
  excess fee refunded by an OVM withdraw / consolidate, then `0x1234…abcd (label) receives 3.200000 ETH` / `pays …`
  per ETH change and `… is credited … in the Warehouse` per Warehouse change. Amounts have 6 decimals (rounded half
  up), below 0.000001 ETH in wei. Deterministic for a given result; no LLM. A revert is one line: `Reverts: <reason>`.
- `matchesPreview` compares where the preview says the same thing as the simulation; `compared` names each check,
  `differences` the failures (`<what>: preview <x>, simulation <y>`), `notCompared` what should have been compared
  and could not be. `status` (3.0.0-rc.12) is `mismatch` when anything differs (a revert included); else
  `notCompared` when nothing was compared (`compared: []`: a preview with nothing comparable) or when a value
  needed was not read (`notCompared` non-empty); else `match`. `ok` is `status === "match"`: it is never true when
  nothing was compared (rc.11 returned `ok: true, compared: []`).
- A before / after read that fails (the whole batch, or one call) is never dropped: Finding
  [`SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE) (warning, `unread`), `matchesPreview.status` is then `notCompared` at best, and the
  unread values are left out of `balanceChanges` and `stateChanges` (absent, not zero). The "before" state of a
  contract the transaction itself creates is not expected and does not count. (3.0.0-rc.12; rc.11 dropped unread
  values, so "not read" looked like "unchanged".)

  | Operation (by the [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) kind)                                       | Compared                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
  | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | [`ovm.prepareDistribute`](./ovm.md#prepareDistribute)                                                  | `DistributeFunds` payouts; `amountOfPrincipalStake` change; push: ETH to each recipient; pull: `fundsPendingWithdrawal` change                                                                                                                                                   |
  | [`splits.prepareDistributeAll`](./splits.md#prepareDistributeAll)                                            | the OVM payouts; each split's `SplitDistributed` amount (none when skipped); each recipient's Warehouse credit from each split (plus its incentive when it is the distributor), its `distributorReward`, and ETH received (from the withdrawal legs, see `prepareDistributeAll`) |
  | [`ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./ovm.md#prepareWithdraw) / `prepareConsolidate`                             | requests (pubkeys, amounts, sources and targets) in order; `value = totalFee`; no request above `maxFeePerRequest`; fees received by the predeploy; the refund received by `excessFeeRecipient`                                                                                  |
  | [`deposits.prepareDeposit`](./deposits.md#prepareDeposit)                                                | deposits (pubkeys in order, total); the deposit contract's ETH change; via the OVM: `amountOfPrincipalStake` change                                                                                                                                                              |
  | [`withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw)                                         | the request from calldata; the fee received by the predeploy                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
  | OVM role and ownership writes                                            | grant / revoke / renounce: the roles after; `setAmountOfPrincipalStake`: before and after; `withdrawPullBalance`: ETH received; `setBeneficiary` / `setRewardRecipient` / `transfer` / `completeOwnershipHandover`: the new recipient and owner; `sweep`: the `Swept` amount     |
  | [`setup.prepareOvmWithSplits`](./setup.md#prepareOvmWithSplits) / `prepareCreateOvm` / `prepareCreateSplit` | the OVM created and its recipients; the splits created are exactly those the preview marks `created`                                                                                                                                                                             |
  | [`incentives.prepareClaim`](./incentives.md#prepareClaim)                                                | the `Claimed` amount                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

Limitations: an untrusted event is shown, not believed; a trusted contract can still behave unexpectedly, which the
balance changes (from the trace) show. A simulation is of one block's state; anything that changes before the transaction is mined (another
distribution, a fee change, a role change) changes the outcome, so simulate just before sending. No gas fees. A Safe
sender is simulated as the Safe calling, not as its `execTransaction`. A Multicall3 batch's inner revert is found by
replaying its calls from Multicall3, where `tx.origin` is Multicall3 instead of the sender (it matters only for the
Warehouse pause bypass). EIP-7002 / EIP-7251 requests are queued, not processed: the simulation says the request is
accepted and the fee paid, not what the beacon chain does with it.

</details>

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: legacy.getOwrTranches (2.15 `getOWRTranches`)</summary>

Tag: `chain`, **experimental** (`obol.experimental.legacy`). Reads an existing OptimisticWithdrawalRecipient's tranches. Kept as a read (design: reads of existing
legacy contracts stay). It reads only the OWR, so it works on any chain the client is on, Gnosis and Sepolia included
(no [`UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN`](../errors.md#UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN); until rc.5 it was mainnet / Hoodi only). [`CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE`](../errors.md#CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE) when the address has no
code, [`CHAIN_READ_FAILED`](../errors.md#CHAIN_READ_FAILED) when `getTranches()` fails.

Placed in two small modules: `withdrawals` (direct EIP-7002 requests from a withdrawal address) and `legacy` (reads
of OWR and SplitMain v1 contracts, no creation).

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>
